review_method: Downloaded five run-specific GitHub Actions artifacts. Visually inspected all five *_review.jpg contact sheets and source previews, extracted independent midpoint frames from each of the five MP4s, independently checked MP4 audio/video streams, and reproduced turtle freeze with ffmpeg scale=180:-2,freezedetect=n=-45dB:d=1.0. Green workflow status is not approval.

issues: Courtship twist block visibly contains source-embedded English labels 'train-rattling'/'wing-shaking'.
End shot lacks clearly visible female inspection; some shots distant or obstructed.
Claw/bark grip described but not clearly demonstrated in the action block.
Several close-ups show head/resting rather than the named behavior.
Opening otter not visibly grooming; several shots are distant, show rocks, or show water rather than fur care.
Ending in zoo enclosure lacks a strong grooming payoff.
New full render now available, but feeding-bill behavior not consistently visible.
Most birds distant; payoff shows raised heads rather than upside-down bill feeding.
Hatchlings too small to recognize on beach.
Research footage includes 'Copyright NHK' embedded text and black bands; source Commons page explicitly records reuse agreement, but embedded watermark remains editorially unacceptable.
Turtle not clearly visible in both seagrass research shots.

remediation_commits.description: Replace two weak/overlay turtle research sources with CC BY 4.0 IFREMER Chelonia mydas sources; align narration to habitat footage.
Replace static turtle payoff source causing >1s freeze with distinct IFREMER Chelonia mydas footage.

notes: Remediated turtle sources are NOT yet visually approved. Other four videos still fail editorial criteria. Do not publish or schedule until fresh five-video QA of newest completed run passes.
